optimus.status: Giga Texas dedicated factory construction is underway. First visible production cells and humanoid training progress expected throughout 2026. Volume production still targeted for 2027+.
key_open_questions: When will we see meaningful volume production (hundreds of units per week)?
Cost per unit vs human labor breakeven economics
Initial target applications (internal Tesla deployment vs external sales)

notable_claims.claim: Factory will be visibly transformative by mid-2026
First production-intent cells expected before end of 2026

cybercab_robotaxi.status: Vehicle unveiled at We, Robot event. Unsupervised regulatory path and production timeline remain the primary gating items. No firm unsupervised deployment date announced yet.
key_open_questions: Regulatory approval timeline for unsupervised operation in the US and key markets
Production start date and initial fleet deployment size
Vehicle cost target and business model (Tesla-owned fleet vs owner-operated)

fsd_unsupervised.status: Supervised FSD continues rapid expansion (v12 → v13 → v14 series). True city-street unsupervised operation remains gated by regulators. China version rebranded 'Assisted Driving' in 2026.
key_open_questions: When will unsupervised FSD receive regulatory approval in any major market?
HW5/AI5 dependency vs current HW4 fleet capability
Long-term impact of China naming/positioning change

hw5_ai5.status: Next-generation inference hardware in active development. Expected to deliver a major leap in capability for both unsupervised FSD and Optimus training/inference.
key_open_questions: Production timeline and vehicle integration path
Dojo supercomputer scaling and training throughput

next_gen_vehicle.status: Development program ongoing with aggressive cost-reduction targets. Still in pre-production; no firm customer launch window announced.
key_open_questions: Final vehicle price target (sub-$30k equivalent or better)
Launch timing and initial geographic markets
Battery chemistry, manufacturing approach, and structural integration

4680_structural_pack.status: Production scaling at Giga Texas and Nevada. Structural pack already shipping in some vehicles. Cell yield, cost curve, and energy density continue to improve.
key_open_questions: Cost per kWh trajectory and path to internal targets
Energy density gains in future 4680 generations
Volume impact on Cybertruck and future vehicle platforms
